guardrails: No hyperparameter or router threshold may be changed after seeing test results.
The MetroPT-3 test set has been repeatedly inspected; all candidate results are exploratory.
Regime thresholds are derived from training data only.
The official calibration split is used only for alert calibration and calibration-stability analysis.
The same alerting protocol is used for all three PCA representations.
Regime-conditioned PCA uses one global StandardScaler fitted on training data.
Every regime PCA uses the same fixed latent dimension derived from global Standard-PCA at 95% training variance.
Exact residual XAI describes detector evidence, not physical root cause.
No result from this benchmark changes the frozen V3 detector.
